name: 137 Chertsey Drive
story: Coffee belongs on the screened porch first. Then the house opens: light through the great room, granite and stainless at the island, a breakfast table in the window. Two bedrooms already live on this floor — the primary with a walk-in, and a private guest suite — so the stairs are optional at night. Upstairs is the overflow: another bedroom, another full bath, and the loft the listing leaves open as media room, play space, office, or gym. Lennar built it in 2012 on a third of an acre in Wellesley East, two-car garage on the street, fence in back. The ask is $469,000.
description: Beautiful and spacious 2-story home in the highly desirable Wellesley East neighborhood of Mooresville! This move-in ready property offers a thoughtfully designed layout with the perfect combination of comfort and style. The main floor features a luxurious primary suite with a walk-in closet and spacious bath, plus a private guest suite—ideal for visitors or multi-generational living. The open great room boasts abundant natural light and flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen, complete with an oversized island, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, pantry, and cozy breakfast area—perfect for hosting gatherings. Upstairs offers even more living space with a generously sized bedroom, full bath, and a huge loft/bonus room that provides endless possibilities—media room, play area, office, or gym. Additional storage space is available to help keep everything organized. Outdoor living is a breeze with a welcoming covered front porch and a screened back porch perfect for morning coffee or unwinding in the evenings. This well-maintained home is located in a sought-after community close to shopping, dining, and top-rated Mooresville schools.
